verdict.rationale: Gitea documents project-planning features: kanban-style project columns, issues with assignments, milestones and due dates (gitea-docs-6, gitea-docs-17, gitea-docs-21). Its API (gitea-docs-4) could in principle back a mobile client. However, nothing in the evidence shows a mobile app, a mobile-optimized or responsive web UI, or any hands-on mobile use, so the defining part of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: an official or documented mobile app, evidence the web UI works on mobile, hands-on reports of managing boards or assigning issues from a phone.
